name: qjs_to_cstring_len2_composition

ownership.argument: Compose the accessor: accept only tag -7, read len from string+4 with the high bit masked off (bit 31 is is_wide_char, so a wide string must be converted rather than copied), allocate len + 1 through js_malloc_rt 0xC2D10F8, copy the payload from string+16, write the NUL, report len and return the pointer. The result is compatible with qjs_free_cstring 0xC278848 because that free path subtracts 16 and releases with tag -7, which is exactly this allocation shape.

provenance.source: The engine exports no to-cstring entry on this build and the constant search found no len + 1 allocation site, so this is composition. astrolink already checks the tag itself before calling (feature.rs tests value >> 32 == -7), so the tag gate is free.
